jobs.name: mayfield-ins-paul-1
jobs.prompt: This is a history documentary about the December 2021 tornado outbreak in Kentucky and Illinois. @char1 sits at his desk and speaks straight to the camera. One full-width 16:9 shot of a single man in a quiet study, never a split image, a collage or panels. Medium shot, the camera does not move. Calm, deep, measured voice, natural small hand movement. He says exactly these words and nothing else: "A tornado warning goes off at work. What do you do? You go where they tell you. Somebody planned for it." He stops speaking and holds his look at the camera. No music, no captions, no text on screen.
